story.tutorial_1_defense.dlg.arsenal3:
I suggest hiding behind the cover to make it harder for enemies to hit us. To do this, stand on the highlighted square.

Cover can stop a bullet if you're not shooting directly from behind it. If your shooting trajectory intersects the cover, it will be highlighted in red.
story.tutorial_1_defense.dlg.arsenal4_ke:
If you ever want to shoot somewhere other than the enemy, hold {0}. The target selection mode activates, and you can use {1} to chose any tile to attack.

We have a barrel with fuel for the flamethrower. You can blow it up with a shot. Just don't catch fire yourself. Fire is very dangerous!

But if you're unlucky enough to catch fire, you can extinguish yourself with any liquid from your inventory. For example, a bottle of water.
story.tutorial_1_defense.dlg.arsenal4_mo:
If you ever want to shoot somewhere other than the enemy, hold {0}. Your cursor will change to a crosshair, and the shooting trajectory will be displayed.

We have a barrel with fuel for the flamethrower. You can blow it up with a shot. Just don't catch fire yourself. Fire is very dangerous!

But if you're unlucky enough to catch fire, you can extinguish yourself with any liquid from your inventory. For example, a bottle of water.
story.tutorial_1_defense.dlg.arsenal5_ke: To the right of the active weapon are its <color=#FFFEC1>attack modes</color>. To change the selected attack mode press {0}.
story.tutorial_1_defense.dlg.arsenal5_mo: To the right of the active weapon is the button to select the <color=#FFFEC1>attack mode</color>. Hover the cursor over it to see the advantages and disadvantages of each.
story.tutorial_1_defense.dlg.diapauseCab:
Let's remember how to move. To step forward press {0}. Use {1} to look around.

In the bottom-left corner of the screen, you'll find your Energy Reserve, Pain Threshold counter, Health, and Movement Mode. The Movement Mode determines how many action points you have until opponents take their turn.

In the locker behind you, you'll find standard equipment. Use it. To open the locker, stand next to it, look toward it with {2}, and press {3} to loot.

To navigate, use {0} on the keyboard.

In the bottom-left corner of the screen, you'll find your Energy Reserve, Pain Threshold counter, Health, and Movement Mode. The Movement Mode determines how many action points you have until opponents take their turn.

Make sure no one is behind you, press {1} to look around. In the locker behind you, you'll find standard equipment. Use it. To open the locker, stand next to it, look toward it with {2}, and press {3} to loot.

Let's remember how to move. To navigate, use {0} on a tile or {1} on the keyboard.

In the bottom-left corner of the screen, you'll find your Energy Reserve, Pain Threshold counter, Health, and Movement Mode. The Movement Mode determines how many action points you have until opponents take their turn.

Make sure no one is behind you. Press {2} to look around. In the locker behind you, you'll find standard equipment. Use it.
Leave the cabin and head to the <color=#FFFEC1>elevator</color>. It's in the room across. We need to eliminate all these bastards.

If you press {0}, you can get information about the <color=#FFFEC1>mission status</color> or request <color=#FFFEC1>evacuation</color> via elevator or shuttle. But right now, we have nowhere to retreat...

To move between station levels, use <color=#FFFEC1>elevators</color> or <color=#FFFEC1>stairs</color>. In the control window, all floors are displayed. I strongly recommend starting with the <color=#FFFEC1>medbay</color>. If we lose the <color=#FFFEC1>bioprinter</color>, there will be serious difficulties in cloning you or other fighters.
story.tutorial_1_defense.dlg.end: Well done, <color=#FFFEC1>Frank</color>. All invaders eliminated, and the <color=#FFFEC1>Magnum</color> is no longer under threat. See you on the <color=#FFFEC1>bridge</color>. Over and out.
story.tutorial_1_defense.dlg.machineBloc: Someone threw <color=#FFFEC1>grenades</color> into the Machine Room again! I'll deal with them later. <color=#FFFEC1>Grenades</color> are used from the <color=#FFFEC1>vest</color> slots. Go to the vest control mode using {0} and select the grenade slot. Once you're done here, head to the <color=#FFFEC1>cubecentric engine</color> on the left.

Someone threw <color=#FFFEC1>grenades</color> into the Machine Room again! I'll deal with them later. <color=#FFFEC1>Grenades</color> are used from the <color=#FFFEC1>vest</color> slots. Activate grenade usage with the corresponding hotkey. Once you're done here, head to the <color=#FFFEC1>cubecentric engine</color> on the left.

Someone threw <color=#FFFEC1>grenades</color> into the Machine Room again! I'll deal with them later. <color=#FFFEC1>Grenades</color> are used from the <color=#FFFEC1>vest</color> slots. Activate grenade usage with the corresponding hotkey or by pressing {0}. Once you're done here, head to the <color=#FFFEC1>cubecentric engine</color> on the left.

Colnodes have barricaded themselves in the upper compartment. Get ready for a serious battle. Use cover and don't play the hero. We have several stationary turrets and mines. They are used in the same way: from the inventory with {0}. Opening the context menu, you need to select Use. After that, you can place them on any adjacent tile. Prepare for defense; we have a little time.

Just in case, the key for skipping a turn is {1}. It might be useful if you need to wait for a few turns.
Destroy them before they blow up the <color=#FFFEC1>cubecentric engine!</color> Protect the <color=#FFFEC1>Magnum</color>.
story.tutorial_1_defense.dlg.medblock1: This is the <color=#FFFEC1>medbay</color>, where the <color=#FFFEC1>bioprinter</color> is located. A perfect place to remind you about your health. If your health reaches zero, you will die. If your pain threshold reaches its limit, you will lose 1 AP. Damage you receive can lead to injuries or limb loss. Keep an eye on that. Take a close look at the <color=#FFFEC1>health interface</color> by pressing {0}.
story.tutorial_1_defense.dlg.medblock2: I'm sending a signal to your computer about a new <color=#FFFEC1>wound</color>. You need to fix it. To do this, press {0} on the medical kit to your right, then select the injured body part.
story.tutorial_1_defense.dlg.medblock3: It seems you've acquired an <color=#FFFEC1>infection</color>. Open your inventory by pressing {0} and use a <color=#FFFEC1>sorbent</color> or <color=#FFFEC1>antibiotic</color>. If the wound is not fixed, the <color=#FFFEC1>infection</color> develops faster.
story.tutorial_1_defense.dlg.medblock4: In extreme cases, you can perform an <color=#FFFEC1>amputation</color>. To do this, select 'amputate' in the context menu of a <color=#FFFEC1>sharp object</color> and choose the <color=#FFFEC1>body part</color>. Note that you can't bandage yourself while in sprint mode.
story.tutorial_1_defense.dlg.medblock5: The <color=#FFFEC1>Autodoc</color> allows you to treat wounds or infections if it has <color=#FFFEC1>charges</color>. You can recharge it with standard <color=#FFFEC1>batteries</color>. Hurry, I've spotted an <color=#FFFEC1>enemy</color> in the room below you. Deal with them.
story.tutorial_1_defense.dlg.medblock6_k: Great job. Pay attention to the corpse. Stand on it or walk up next to it, look towards it with {0} and press {1} to <color=#FFFEC1>loot</color> it. When you're done here, return to the elevator and descend to the next level. In the top right corner, there's a minimap {2} and the current mission status {3}. Use these buttons if you forget what's happening.
story.tutorial_1_defense.dlg.medblock6_m: Great job. Pay attention to the corpse. Click on it to <color=#FFFEC1>loot</color> it. If you want to <color=#FFFEC1>stand on the corpse</color> without inspecting it, use {0} for movement. When you're done here, return to the elevator and descend to the next level. In the top right corner, there's a <color=#FFFEC1>minimap</color> and the current <color=#FFFEC1>mission status</color>. Use these buttons if you forget what's happening.
story.tutorial_1_defense.objective_check: Open your Inventory and cure the infection
story.tutorial_1_defense.objective0: Clear the invaders from all floors of the Magnum.

story.tutorial_2_revenge.after:
We not only took all the valuables, but also patched up the holes from the boarding shuttles. We also found a PCPU with a database belonging to the AnCom corporation. There is a lot of information about quasimorphosis research.

They are willing to generously compensate our expenses for the return of such valuable intellectual property. Of course, we made a copy of all the data from their device. Their agent is ready to meet us in Rebus Sky City, in the orbit of Mars.
story.tutorial_2_revenge.briefing:
Bear in mind that we're not getting paid for this. Taking a contract would have been a better idea. The Civil Resistance has set up a field camp in Rogue City. Training complexes, as well as something that looks like a laboratory.

Sometimes messages flash in the SBN that the terrorists are accumulating weapons and equipment for their “liberation struggle”. So, let’s justify the time spent on this escapade: we’ll get revenge and profit from it. Get to their anti-space defense complex and destroy it. After that, the pilots will direct the Magnum to the cargo dock in Rogue City, and we will start loading everything that's lying there.
story.tutorial_2_revenge.desc: The Rogue City station's autonomous missile defense <color=#FFFEC1>server must be destroyed</color>.
story.tutorial_2_revenge.details: The <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> colnodes attempted to attack our mobile headquarters. We have successfully fought back and must now counterattack their training center.
story.tutorial_2_revenge.dlg.cargodock1:
Our scanners see several ways to solve this problem. First, there is the main elevator connecting the cargo dock to the control center, but the number of biosignatures at the elevator is extremely high. Secondly, there is a bypass route via the stairs and warehouse level.

I would recommend using the second option as our main plan, but if you feel confident, you can try to get through the security around the elevator.
story.tutorial_2_revenge.dlg.cargodock2: The <color=#FFFEC1>elevator</color> is somewhere nearby. Be careful, the signatures of stationary turrets and heavily armored <color=#FFFEC1>colnodes</color> are clearly visible there.
story.tutorial_2_revenge.dlg.cargodock3: These <color=#FFFEC1>stairs</color> leads to the warehouse. We have enhanced the resolution capability of the geoscanner. There's medical supplies and some other equipment there. Collect the items and head to the <color=#FFFEC1>SD control center</color>.
story.tutorial_2_revenge.dlg.cmdcenter1:
Finally, you're at the SD control center. It's full of Civil Resistance fighters. A bioscanner is registering spikes in their endocrine systems... It's some kind of madness. Maybe there's a way to bypass them? Pay attention to the technical corridors and ventilation shafts. If you picked up heavy weaponry from the warehouse, you shouldn't have many problems.

Once you find their PCO control computer, just destroy it with whatever's at hand.
story.tutorial_2_revenge.dlg.cmdcenter2: Great job. The pilots began maneuvering as soon as the geoscanner beeped that the <color=#FFFEC1>Rogue City</color> guns had died. Mission accomplished. Request <color=#FFFEC1>evacuation</color> and return to the nearest <color=#FFFEC1>elevator</color>.
story.tutorial_2_revenge.name: Taste of Revenge
story.tutorial_2_revenge.objective0: Destroy Rogue City station's missile defense control center.
story.tutorial_2_revenge.objective1: The missile defense control center has been successfully destroyed. We can evacuate.
story.tutorial_2_revenge.stage1.name: Landing Dock
story.tutorial_2_revenge.stage2.name: Warehouses
story.tutorial_2_revenge.stage3.name: Control Center
story.unc_1_ghoul.after: We managed to ruin relations not only with <color=#FFFEC1>CoreWard MG</color>, but also with <color=#FFFEC1>Dilthey</color>. The SBN is thick with their protest notes, and the Unchained Belt reports that they just picked up a spacecraft abandoned by a vile <color=#FFFEC1>PMC</color>. Let's hope the reward was worth it.
story.unc_1_ghoul.briefing: The shuttle has been detected, so prepare for fierce defense from CoreWard MG security. In addition, we have a new problem: a security system has been installed at the armory level. A signal has been sent from there to block the spacecraft's controls. You will have to get there and disable the block. The pirate tanker is already nearby.
story.unc_1_ghoul.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Take control of the <color=#FFFEC1>HIS Woodpecker</color> and fly it to the temporary pirate base.
story.unc_1_ghoul.details:
Details: Pirates from the Unchained Belt want to get their hands on a powerful weapon: a Heavy Interplanetary Spacecraft. We must steal for them the HIS Woodpecker, which CoreWard MG uses as a base of operations in the Main Belt. But first it has to be refueled, and the agents of the Unchained Belt will help us with this.

Additional Info: The HIS Woodpecker, in orbit around Vesta, has long been used by CoreWard MG as a stationary checkpoint in the Main Belt. The pirates have found out that its cubecentric engines are fully functional. If the spacecraft is filled with G-3 quantum fuel, it will easily leave orbit.
story.unc_1_ghoul.dlg.coreward_dilthey_a: Attention! The sale of HIS Woodpecker to <color=#FFFEC1>Dilthey Corporation</color> has been completed. CoreWard MG disclaims liability for the asset.
story.unc_1_ghoul.dlg.dilthey_dilthey_ar: Attention! We ask all unauthorized personnel to leave the HIS Woodpecker. It is the private property of the <color=#FFFEC1>Dilthey</color> Corporation. The corporation's <color=#FFFEC1>security officers</color> will be transported here from the nearby cargo spacecraft Nikolaus Otto to ensure the asset's safety.
story.unc_1_ghoul.dlg.jane_arsenal_destr: Security system disabled. Spacecraft control unlocked.
story.unc_1_ghoul.dlg.jane_arsenal_enter: You need to disable the <color=#FFFEC1>security system</color> in the armory. The <color=#FFFEC1>CoreWard MG</color> security team has blocked the spacecraft's control system. Find the mainframe and deal with it... as best you can.
story.unc_1_ghoul.dlg.jane_cc_cleared: There is nothing else stopping us. Head to <color=#FFFEC1>Interamnia</color>.
story.unc_1_ghoul.dlg.jane_cc_no_objecti: You can clear out the entire spacecraft, but the bird <color=#FFFEC1>won't fly</color> while the quantum fuel tanks are <color=#FFFEC1>empty</color> and the armory's security system is <color=#FFFEC1>working</color>. First, clear out these floors.
story.unc_1_ghoul.dlg.jane_cc_start_defe: Eliminate anyone who might prevent us from taking control of the spacecraft. After that, we'll take the bird to its new nest.
story.unc_1_ghoul.dlg.jane_fuel_is_compl: The pirate tanker has undocked. Make your way to the command floor. Remember that <color=#FFFEC1>Dilthey truck that flew past? It dropped off a whole bunch of <color=#FFFEC1>armed combatants</color>. Good luck.
story.unc_1_ghoul.dlg.jane_fuel_room: Protect the engines while the refueling is in process.
story.unc_1_ghoul.dlg.jane_fuel_room_bef: First you need to destroy the <color=#FFFEC1>mainframe in the Arsenal</color>.
story.unc_1_ghoul.dlg.jane_machine_enter: Receiving encrypted signal from the <color=#FFFEC1>fuel shuttle</color>. They will be ready as soon as you <color=#FFFEC1>clear this level</color>.
story.unc_1_ghoul.dlg.jane_on_arrival: A truck from the <color=#FFFEC1>Dilthey</color> corporation is moving nearby at a relatively low speed. I don't know what they want, but if they detect a fuel shuttle, they can transmit this information to the <color=#FFFEC1>HIS Woodpecker</color>. Dilthey are some good Samaritans.
story.unc_1_ghoul.dlg.unchainedbelt_cont:
This is Unchained Belt speaking. Accept the transmission...

I see you've got a knack for ruining relationships with the bigwigs of the corporate world. Ever since that cute little beastie threw a party on Venus, you've done a lot to make the AnCap system look at you with suspicion. Yes, we know about Tezctlan. We know it's not a fake. We have eyes in the Inner System, too.

In short, we need a contractor like you. For certain reasons, we don't want to take direct action against corporations that have an active interest in the Belt. After all, we all share these rocks together. It's not time to upset the delicate balance yet, but it's nice to tweak a few things. Your target is CoreWard MG. You'll attack and capture their HIS Woodpecker in orbit around Vesta, and then send it into orbit around Interamnia. Of course, the ship will have to be refueled first. This is not a problem if you provide our guys with access to the engine level.

For you, a well-paid job, for us—a valuable new asset. And for the Belt, a small increase in tension instead of a full-fledged war. Is there any reason to refuse such a contract?
story.unc_1_ghoul.dlg.unchainedbelt_dilt: We don't care how you planned to build relations with <color=#FFFEC1>Dilthey</color>. The contract must be fulfilled in any case. There is not much time left until the end of the refueling.
story.unc_1_ghoul.dlg.unchainedbelt_fuel: We're heading to the fuel lock. It'll take a while to refuel. The boss asked me to thank you for your part in the <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color> case if you make it this far. We've got a few guys here who are eager to fight. We'll drop them on your floor.
story.unc_1_ghoul.name: Ship of Ghouls
story.unc_1_ghoul.objective0: We need to shut down the arsenal, refuel the <color=#FFFEC1>HIS Woodpecker</color>, and fly it to Interamnia.
story.unc_1_ghoul.objective1: Now this is a new pirate spacecraft.

story.xio_1_sinkhole.dlg.jane_after_ladd: We're utilizing the effect of surprise. Our techies have hacked into the Sinkhole Oasis servers and are overloading the network with information noise. You have some time to find the <color=#FFFEC1>Spear</color> that <color=#FFFEC1>Lady Xiomara</color> mentioned. And, if possible, to gather any valuable data.
story.xio_1_sinkhole.dlg.jane_attacked_m: Well, that was a bad idea. A very bad idea. Firstly, you didn't budge a single atom of this thing with your shot. Secondly, the alarm went off. All the armed <color=#FFFEC1>RealWare</color> security operators are heading your way. We need some information on this Monolith. Gather it, and we'll get you out.
story.xio_1_sinkhole.dlg.jane_see_monoli: What do you see? Our geoscanner froze up, outputting data that gave our operator a seizure. What on earth is in there? No wonder <color=#FFFEC1>RealWare</color> is so diligently filtering access to Sinkhole Oasis. Try to destroy that damn thing. The <color=#FFFEC1>Spear</color> is probably inside.
story.xio_1_sinkhole.dlg.space_eipschwit:
Exactly. You understand NOTHING! This is a priceless find. The Monolith not only phased into our realm from the bramfatura of Mars, but at the time of phasing, it was something entirely different than just a stone. Your problems won't be solved by anyone other than Dr. Eipshwitz. Since I'm now traveling on your spacecraft, can I finally be considered your employee? Come on, come on. Let's get closer to mutually beneficial cooperation. NCE. Freedom to Contract. Remember?

Well, well... I'll need my Telephaturic Dislocator, several boxes of spare parts and repair kits, and I'll need a lab space on the spacecraft and a lab coat... Ah, no. No coat needed. But a couple of handy assistants are.

Where did I put the Dislocator? You didn't take it back from Mercury? Then it should still be at Flat Obsidian, in the field camp. We need to collect it from there so I can get to work.
story.xio_1_sinkhole.dlg.space_jane_afte: We have decrypted the data we acquired. It looks as if this entire Monolith is nothing but a phased feature. But first of all, this event occurred about a billion years ago, and second, it completely defies the laws of our universe. We’re not the first to try to break it. <color=#FFFEC1>RealWare</color> has tried every weapon available to them, including a controlled nuclear blast. The result? Nothing. Looks like we know nothing...
story.xio_1_sinkhole.name: Sinkhole Oasis
story.xio_1_sinkhole.objective0: Find the <color=#FFFEC1>Itzpapalotl</color>, the Spear of Tezctlan
story.xio_1_sinkhole.stage1.name: Find the object
story.xio_2_madness.after: <color=#FFFEC1>Eipschwitz</color> is still catatonic. We hooked him up to a virtual simulation and, by repeating his actions, assembled some kind of device. The doctor called it, "the ultimate solution to the damn terrorists and quasimorphs." It's obviously a <color=#FFFEC1>bomb</color>. If we can locate the necessary components, we can get production on stream. With a weapon like that, we could try to raid the <color=#FFFEC1>Sinkhole Oasis</color> and destroy the <color=#FFFEC1>Monolith</color>. It sounds <color=#FFFEC1>dangerous</color>, Boss, but it’s the best plan we’ve got.
story.xio_2_madness.briefing: Sensors show human marks. Without signatures. They could be <color=#FFFEC1>PMC</color> or someone else. Be prepared for contact.
story.xio_2_madness.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Prepare the site for loading of the <color=#FFFEC1>Telefaturic Dislocator</color>.
